QEPhonopy20260912.coordinate_transform: Rotate Cartesian q and eigenvectors by -60 degrees about z. Site a1 = rotated (native a2 - native a1), a2 = -rotated native a1; site basis A=(0,0), B=(0,bond_nm).
QEPhonopy20260912.phase_convention: Cell phase exp(i Q.R): multiply rotated Phonopy atomic-gauge eigenvector by exp(i Q.tau_s). Render Re[e_cell exp(i Q.R-i phase)]. Equal carbon masses allow common amplitude normalization.
QEPhonopy20260912.branch_tracking: Eigenvector-overlap assignment within each path segment. Identify ZA/ZO and LA/TA/LO/TO near Γ by frequency and polarization; seed K–M from its nondegenerate M end. Only eigenspaces with frequency splitting below 0.002 cm^-1 are rotated for a continuous basis; raw frequencies are retained.
QEPhonopy20260912.gamma_basis: Project Cartesian translation and opposite-sublattice directions into calculated acoustic and optical eigenspaces. The endpoint uses its approaching path direction for L/T.
QEPhonopy20260912.path_sampling: 303 raw points; remove repeated K and M start points, yielding 301 selectable Q nodes. No eigenvector interpolation.
QEPhonopy20260912.limitations: Fixed standard lattice, no cell relaxation. Finite 5x5 force-constant range and 2x2 force k-mesh; no convergence study or fitted correction applied.

phonons.mode_order: Increasing frequency at each Q; branch_of maps each frequency index to a continuous physical branch.
